paragraphs: A near shore buoyancy aid is rated to turn an unconscious wearer face up, which is the only specification that actually matters. Orange is not a style decision either: it is the colour that stays visible longest against grey water.
The model is extremely light at 4,849 polygons and 4,889 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, in the worn position. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $29 it suits marine safety and boating visualisation, training material, character accessories, e-commerce imagery, film props and game environments. On sale since 2025.

Marshmallow is mostly air held in a sugar and gelatine foam, which is why it toasts rather than melts. Sold in a tub, the product is presented by volume rather than weight, and the packaging is doing the persuading.
This is a collection listing rather than a single object, supplying the containers as static pieces. It is built to CheckMate specification, and two further volumes of the set are offered separately.
At $29 the set suits food and confectionery visualisation, packaging and e-commerce imagery, advertising, kitchen and retail scenes, film set dressing and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

Toothpaste in a metal tube is a deliberate anachronism. It costs more to make, it crumples permanently, and it exists because the material signals craft in a category where every competitor uses plastic.
The model is supplied in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, and is built to CheckMate specification.
At $29 it suits product and packaging visualisation, e-commerce and retail imagery, advertising, bathroom and interior scenes, film set dressing and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

A large volume syringe is rarely used for injection. Thirty millilitres is a flushing and irrigation size, used for wounds, tubes and catheters, and the plunger is sized for a hand rather than a thumb.
The model is very light at 8,842 polygons and 8,897 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, so it runs in interactive material. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $29 it suits medical device marketing, clinical and nursing education, patient explanation, technical documentation, film props and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

A piped meringue holds its shape because the sugar has been dissolved into whipped egg white and then dried rather than baked. The peak on top is the signature of the nozzle, and it is the first thing a pastry chef is judged on.
The model is extremely light at 2,745 polygons and 2,695 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $29 it suits food and confectionery visualisation, menu and packaging imagery, advertising, patisserie and cafe scenes, film set dressing and editorial illustration. On sale since 2024.

Point of care coagulation testing moved a laboratory measurement into a clinic and then into a patient's home. For anybody on long term anticoagulants that changed the rhythm of the condition from monthly appointments to a finger prick.
The model is very light at 6,733 polygons and 6,992 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 8 maps all at 4096x4096. It carries StemCell certification.
At $29 it suits medical device marketing, clinical and patient education, e-commerce imagery, healthcare interiors, technical documentation and editorial illustration. On sale since 2021.

A splash is one of the hardest things to photograph and one of the easiest to model badly. The crown shape that liquid makes on impact lasts a few milliseconds, and having it as geometry means it can be lit and posed rather than caught.
The model is extremely light at 3,403 polygons and 3,510 vertices in quads and tris with mixed UV layout. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $29 it suits food and beverage advertising, packaging and product visualisation, motion graphics, dairy and nutrition imagery, and editorial illustration. On sale since 2026.

Voxel characters work because the eye fills in what the blocks leave out. A skeleton reduced to rectangles is still unmistakably a skeleton, and the low resolution is a style decision that turned into an entire visual language.

The model is very light at 7,890 polygons and 7,888 vertices, built in quads only with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 2 maps at 256x256, which is exactly right for the aesthetic. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification, and a rigged build is offered separately.
At $29 it suits game characters, animation and children's media, fan illustration, merchandise visualisation and editorial work. On sale since 2016.

Directional mines are aimed rather than buried, which makes them a different clearance problem entirely: they sit above ground, on legs or clamps, and are usually found rather than detected. Awareness imagery matters as much as military reference here.
The model is very light at 6,160 polygons and 6,423 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 5 maps all at 4096x4096. It carries StemCell certification.
At $29 it suits demining and humanitarian visualisation, documentary and news graphics, training material, film props and editorial illustration. On sale since 2021.

The money gun is a prop that only exists because of video. It has no function beyond producing a shot, it was invented for music promos and nightclubs, and it is one of the purest examples of an object designed for a camera.
The model is very light at 8,425 polygons and 8,746 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 5 maps all at 2048x2048. It carries StemCell certification.
At $29 it suits advertising and music video props, party and event scenes, film and television, game assets, editorial illustration and motion graphics. On sale since 2020.

Goggles predate the full face helmet and never entirely went away. On an open face helmet they are still the only thing between the rider and everything the road throws up, and the strap and foam are doing more work than the lens.
The model is very light at 11,254 polygons and 11,278 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 6 maps all at 4096x4096. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $29 it suits apparel and equipment visualisation, e-commerce imagery, character accessories, period and motorcycle scenes, film costume and editorial illustration. On sale since 2026.

The rating refers to filtration efficiency against particles at the hardest size to catch, which is not the largest. Everything about the shape, the nose clip and the two straps exists to stop air going around the filter instead of through it.
The model is extremely light at 1,932 polygons and 1,978 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $29 it suits medical and public health visualisation, safety equipment marketing, character accessories, e-commerce imagery, film props and editorial illustration. On sale since 2021.

Neptune is the only planet found by mathematics before anybody looked at it. Its position was predicted from irregularities in the orbit of Uranus, and the telescope was pointed at the answer rather than at a search.
The model carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $29 it suits space and astronomy visualisation, education and museum work, news and documentary graphics, planetarium and motion graphics, and editorial illustration. On sale since 2016.

Infant cereal packaging carries more regulated text than almost any other food product. Age guidance, preparation instructions and nutritional declarations are all mandatory, which leaves the designer very little space to work in.
The model is extremely light at 4,028 polygons and 2,035 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $29 it suits packaging and label mockups, food and retail visualisation, e-commerce imagery, kitchen and nursery scenes, advertising and editorial illustration. On sale since 2022.
